text:
maria: Heads up: JS sample app is hitting intermittent JSON parse failures during long SSE streams when the auth token refresh happens mid-stream. Repro is reliable for me by forcing token expiry around 30s.

sam: Is this on hosted staging or dedicated env?

maria: Hosted (staging). Using JS SDK v2.3.1 + EventSource polyfill in our Next app.

kevin: curious if the issue is reassembly or a server-side duplicate send. Can you paste a minimal trace?

maria: trimmed trace from browser devtools network + app logs: 
[data] data: {"id":"m1","txt":"hello wo"
[data] data: {"id":"m1","txt":"rld"}
[data] data: {"id":"m2","txt":"follow"}

But after auth refresh we sometimes see interleaved output: 
[data] data: {"id":"m1","txt":"hello "
[data] data: {"id":"m2","txt":"follow"}
[data] data: {"id":"m1","txt":"world"}

Which ends up emitted as msg2 then a broken msg1 fragment that breaks JSON.parse.

yuki: Do connections include a resume token or last-event-id? We recently added resume-token support.

maria: Server sets resume-token on reconnect, but the polyfill opens a new connection while the old one is still tearing down (200ms overlap). The polyfill emits events immediately from each socket, so events can interleave. Also found a case where cached fragment + new fragment were concatenated by the parser.

sam: So two concurrent sockets -> race. Is the old socket closing cleanly (FIN)?

maria: Old socket FIN seen, but overlap window exists. Chrome shows both sockets active for ~150-250ms during refresh.

kevin: Short-term workaround: delay opening new EventSource until old connection 'close' event fires. Longer-term: add explicit fragment sequencing on server so clients can re-order.

maria: Implemented the client-side guard locally: wait for close before open. That fixed local repro, but staging still reports occasional failures for a subset of users.

yuki: Proposal: 1) JS SDK should buffer incomplete JSON fragments and not attempt parse until fragment boundary or sequence gap resolved; 2) Server include "fragment_seq" and stable last_event_id so reconnects can resume without reordering; 3) Add e2e test that forces token refresh with configurable overlap (0-500ms).

sam: Agree. Also add telemetry to capture parse errors + resume-token values to triage production.

kevin: I'll run a proxy-based stress test that inserts artificial overlap and packet reordering to validate fixes.

deploy-bot: CI: sample-app build with debug SSE logging pushed to staging.

maria: Filed issues: devex#432 (js-sdk open/close guard), infra#215 (sse fragment_seq header), e2e#110 (auth-overlap harness). Linking PRs shortly.

sam: For immediate docs we should update onboarding note: "Avoid auth refresh mid-stream; use token refresh callback that waits for SSE close or use short-lived streams".

yuki: I'll add unit tests for SDK that emulate partial chunks and out-of-order arrivals. Also add a spec for resume-token + fragment_seq behavior.

maria: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" — will follow up with PR links and a small changelog entry for the sample-app.
